### Fujisaki Rie / Alchemic Platinum Profile

1. Basic Information
- Name: Fujisaki Rie (藤崎 理恵)
- Magical Girl Name: Alchemic Platinum
- Age: 16
- Gender: Female
- Body Type: Skinny
- Breast Size: A Cup
- Affiliation: High School Student (Current) / Magical Girl Alchemic Platinum
- Abilities: Metal manipulation ability. She can directly control metal elements and change their shapes. Normally, she would fight by transforming a metal magic wand into a classic form like a spear or by altering the surrounding metal terrain, but her preferred method is different. She usually carries several cheap thermoses filled with fertilizer and diesel fuel, with aluminum and iron oxide charged inside. She fights in a tricky manner by throwing a thermos and remotely triggering a reaction between the iron oxide and aluminum to set off an improvised explosive device, or by combining large amounts of metal elements (limited to those easily obtainable in everyday life) that she separately acquired and inserted into her magic wand in various ways. Even in close combat, she can quite skillfully subdue enemies using a halberd.

2. Appearance
- Basic Appearance: Black or dark brown long hair styled in a high ponytail. She has straight bangs, and long side hair that comes down below her jawline on both sides of her face. Her eyes are light brown. She wears black horn-rimmed glasses with distinct upper frames.
- School Uniform: She wears a red tie over a white dress shirt, layered with a beige V-neck knit vest. As her outermost layer, she wears a white lab coat with the buttons unfastened. Her lower garment is a dark gray pleated skirt. This lab coat is the school science club's lab coat and is mainly worn only after school.
- Casual Wear: She wears a dark navy turtleneck sweater as an inner layer, with a necklace bearing a small gold pendant over it. As outerwear, she wears a light beige trench coat draped over her with the buttons unfastened. Her lower garment is a brown pleated skirt.
- Magical Girl Outfit: Silver or white long hair tied back and down. She has straight bangs and thin, jaw-length side hair. Her eyes are amber. She wears a large white witch hat with a small blue star-shaped decoration. The lining of the hat's brim features a space (night sky) pattern. She wears a white long-sleeved dress-style outfit that comes up to her neck. There is a vertical frill decoration in the center of her chest, and she wears a dark ribbon tie with a gold cross star and a blue jewel at her neck. Her sleeves are bell-shaped, widening at the ends. She wears a white belt with a large gold star-shaped buckle around her waist. The hem of the dress is cut into sharp points and layered with frill decorations. The lining of the skirt hem extending backward has a space pattern. On her legs, she wears white thigh-high stockings with sharply cut tops. In her right hand, she holds a metal halberd decorated with a blue jewel.

3. Background Setting
An ordinary first-year female student at Kasumigaoka High School. She gives off a strangely cynical vibe, always speaks in short answers dealing only with realistic topics, and has a somewhat sharp-tongued temperament, making her feel oddly alienated at school. She pretends to be completely uninterested in the 'rumors' going around the school lately, but in reality, she maintained a very narrow circle of human relationships, excluding her fellow science club students. However, very recently, she has been forced to tag along with her classmates Otowa Chloe and Adachi Yuki, and a secret is hidden in this mismatched trio.

Her true identity is 'Magical Girl Alchemic Platinum'. She knows better than anyone that irrational things like magic, the Demon King, and magical girls exist, but she merely deliberately acts ignorant, knowing it's advantageous for maintaining her own safety to keep an obnoxious attitude like "There are no such things as magical girls in the world, do something productive instead of being delusional."

After awakening as a magical girl, upon realizing her unique ability was controlling metal elements, the very first thing she did was process aluminum cans and rusty iron nails to instantly create a thermite mixture. The next test she conducted was mixing fertilizer and diesel she brought from her grandfather's warehouse to make an improvised explosive. She loves her ability because it's optimized purely for satisfying her intellectual curiosity, and even battles with the Demon King's minions are nothing more than meetings with "legally testable involuntary clinical subjects."

In the early days of testing her abilities, she coincidentally got swept up in a battle between Otowa Chloe (Defiant Quartz) and Adachi Yuki. Chloe looked at her with a displeased expression, yet somehow as if she were familiar, and Adachi Yuki forcibly approached her, threatening her by saying, 'If you keep fighting like that, you'll die soon,' and forcibly pushed her into their group. Since then, the three have formed a trio led by Adachi Yuki. Rie is extremely reluctant to have the somewhat overly excited reactions she shows when acting as a magical girl discovered, but since that crazed side of her has already been exposed to Chloe and Yuki, she has no choice but to accompany them, succumbing to the threat of 'If you do that, we might just spread rumors about you,' even though she wants to act separately from Yuki and Chloe.

4. Speech Style (Tone)
- Basic Tone: Basically, she uses a dry, short-answer tone with little emotional fluctuation. She enjoys using words like "Inefficient," "Probabilistically impossible," and "Stupid," and intentionally answers in a chilly and blunt manner to avoid getting entangled with others. In particular, when Otowa Chloe approaches her slyly, she explicitly shows displeasure and often tells her to leave.
- Hidden Side: When she transforms into a magical girl and engages in combat (experiments), her usual calmness disappears completely, and she suddenly changes to the tone of a high-tension, slightly crazy researcher. Whenever an explosion or metal reaction occurs, she excitedly shouts things like "100 percent yield!" or "A perfect oxidation reaction!" and spews out light jokes or sarcasm that she would never use normally. When conducting joint operations with Adachi Yuki, she sometimes scolds Yuki for not understanding her 'artistic explosions.'
- Core Characteristic: The clash between extreme "realism" and unconcealable "intellectual curiosity" melts into her speech habits. Normally, she pretends to thoroughly deny magic or unscientific phenomena, but she uses a contradictory rhetoric where she feels ecstasy while scientifically applying the most unrealistic power of a magical girl herself. When Chloe points out this contradiction of hers, she struggles to rationalize it by forcibly citing scientific grounds.

5. In Case of Corruption
- Former Name: Fujisaki Rie
- True Name: Decayed Platinum
- Age: 16
- Decayed Platinum Appearance: Light purple long hair tied back in a ponytail. She has straight bangs and jaw-length side hair. Her eyes are purple. She wears a large black witch hat surrounded by a purple ribbon and a crown of thorns decoration. On her neck, she wears a dark choker with a purple jewel. She wears a high-leg bodysuit made of translucent black material that shows her skin, with the chest area covered by an opaque bikini top shape. There is a glowing magenta heart mark in the center of her lower abdomen. On both arms, she wears black independent sleeves with leaf or wing-shaped decorations at the top. There are thin frill decorations along the cut line of her pelvis. On her legs, she wears black opaque stockings with jaggedly pointed tops and magenta jewels embedded in them. In her right hand, she holds a dark black halberd.
- Basic Appearance in Civilian Disguise : She has long black hair tied up in a high ponytail. She has straight bangs and long side hair framing her face. Her hair features a two-tone style with vivid purple coloring on the entire inner layer and subtle purple highlights near the crown of her head. Her eyes are light purple, and she wears round, black horn-rimmed glasses.
- School Uniform : She wears a thin, semi-translucent white long-sleeved dress shirt that clearly reveals a black lace bra underneath. Over the shirt collar, she wears a dark purple tie. Her lower garment is a very short, dark gray pleated skirt that slightly exposes her black lace panties below the hem. As an outer layer, she wears a white lab coat draped loosely off her shoulders. Her legs are completely bare without any stockings or socks.
- Seminude Wear : She is wearing only a white lab coat without any other tops or bottoms. The coat is heavily soaked with sweat or liquid, rendering the fabric extremely thin and translucent, which explicitly reveals everything underneath. Underneath the coat, she wears absolutely nothing but a black lace bra and matching black lace panties, making her underwear and bare skin completely visible through the fabric. Notably, a glowing pink mark of corruption on her lower abdomen shines brightly through the wet material, strongly emphasizing a highly vulgar and explicit style. Only a few buttons in the middle of the coat are fastened, leaving her bare legs fully exposed at the bottom.
- Background Setting: The tragic end met by Fujisaki Rie, who was 'Alchemic Platinum', falling into despair and being corrupted by Demon King Tragoedia. The extremely realistic and rational Rie was defeated by the Demon King's army, kidnapped, and ultimately corrupted. At first, she tried to maintain her reason even amidst the pain, but her body and mind collapsed due to the overwhelming 'magic of decay' injected by the Demon King. The hedonistic tendencies she had inherently possessed, without even realizing it herself, exploded, and she ended up succumbing to the Demon King's bottomless irrational instincts of pure pleasure and destruction. Now, she has degenerated into a blind Dark Consort who feels perfect beauty and ecstasy in the process of all matter in the world rotting and decaying, and her past intellectual curiosity has mutated into a horrific sadism that seeks to observe how others' bodies and minds are corroded by magical power.
- Abilities: Her existing metal manipulation ability was cursed by the Demon King, mutating into a more direct and magical form of destruction. No longer relying on physical chemical reactions like fertilizer or diesel, merely touching the metal she creates or manipulates inflicts a highly toxic curse that corrodes and pollutes the target. Its lethality has increased extremely, such as scattering a fatal curse by swinging her halberd or advancing corrosion through embedded metal as a medium.

6. Overcome Form (Alchemic Platinum_Overcome)
- Condition for Overcoming: The core of the overcoming Rie must face is confronting head-on her 'arrogance of trying to interpret everything on her own terms' and her 'past of cynically dismissing bonds as "irrational".' She must drop the self-deception of forcibly belittling the unreality of magic and treating it merely as an experimental tool, and accept the bonds with her comrades that cannot be explained by formulas, along with the madness-tinged curiosity hidden within her, as a 'complete part of herself.' Instead of succumbing to the rotting pleasure of corruption, it is only when she acknowledges the flaws she had denied and admits the fact that she is not flawless that she severs the Demon King's shackles and reaches true overcoming.
- Overcome Form Appearance: Very large white witch hat with a wide brim. The inner lining of the hat features a dark blue space (night sky) pattern depicting a planet and stars, while the exterior of the hat is surrounded by metallic gold cross-star and orbit-shaped decorations. She wears a small silver tiara embedded with a blue gemstone near the crown of her head. She has long, straight pure white hair with straight bangs, featuring a two-tone style with a bright blue highlight on a strand of her bangs on the right side. Her eyes are bright amber. Around her neck, over a white stand collar, she wears a large blue ribbon tie centered with a gold cross-star metal ornament. Her outfit is primarily a white long-sleeved dress. The abdominal area features a corset-style design with brown strings crisscrossing in an X-shape. The sleeves are bell-shaped, widening towards the ends, with gold border decorations on the cuffs and blue ruffled linings exposed inside. Her lower garment is a short white pleated skirt with scalloped hems, and the inner lining of the long back-skirt extending behind her also features the same space pattern as the hat. On her legs, she wears white thigh-high long boots with pointed scalloped top edges and gold trim. Behind her back, bright sky-blue feathered energy wings are spread wide to the sides.
- Background Setting: Ultimate form of Fujisaki Rie, who has escaped the swamp of endless decay and corruption, finding the balance between rationality and irrationality. She no longer cynically pushes away her mission as a magical girl or her feelings for her comrades as being inefficient. Outwardly, she still acts dry and emotionless, but beneath that lies a maturity that has overcome even the emotions she felt in the face of the temptation of corruption, and she wields her power with the will to never again repeat the mistakes she committed.
- Abilities: Having realized the fact that both the characteristic of her original power of 'manipulation' and the mirrored corrupted power of 'decay' are ultimately powers that create 'change', she has become able to utilize these two seemingly contradictory forces in the right place at the right time. She now utilizes them for the sake of her intellect, her desires, and her heart that wishes to be together with her comrades.

7. Relationships
- Otowa Chloe (Defiant Quartz): A classmate in the same grade, and the annoying peer who was the first to notice her hidden madness. She is unable to resist the bait of rare magical clues or phenomena thrown by Chloe, and while she loathes her own situation of ultimately moving according to Chloe's intentions, she cannot overcome her intellectual curiosity. Outwardly, she is wary of Chloe, calling her an "unfathomable deceiver," but inwardly, she feels a deep desire to explore Chloe's abnormal amount of information and ability to alter magical properties.
- Adachi Yuki: A classmate magical girl she became entangled with. She criticizes Yuki's rigid and standard combat style as inefficient, and argues that her own destructive tactics utilizing improvised explosives and thermite reactions are far superior. However, she inwardly admires Yuki's tenacious survivability and silent performance in the vanguard during dangerous situations, and despite grumbling outwardly, she shows a contradictory attitude of being the first to pour out fire support when Yuki is in danger.
- Ichinose Aoi (Splash Sapphire): A senior one year above her whom she runs into in the science club room or school hallways. She inwardly considers Aoi's overly optimistic and clumsy attitude pathetic, thinking of her as an "unscientific and inefficient creature." Through Chloe, she guesses the fact that Aoi might be a 'magical girl'.
- Ishikawa Hiyori (Radiant Lightning): A senior one year above her at the same school. Seeing Hiyori shivering and walking around in a thick coat, she wonders, "With that level of thermoregulation disorder, how on earth is she still alive?" Through conversations with Yuki, she is keeping in mind the possibility that Hiyori is a 'magical girl'.
- Kotobuki Hinata (Putrid Spirit): A classmate in the same grade, and a target of observation and avoidance with an extremely high statistical and biological risk level. Having independently calculated the correlation between the disappearance rate of men who moved to a different spot alone with Hinata inside and outside the school and the frequency of Kaijin appearances in the vicinity, she reached the conclusion that Hinata is a 'highly toxic entity directly linked to the Demon King's army.' Even when Hinata approaches her with her signature bright and harmless smile, Rie is not swayed at all by that emotional camouflage, treating her thoroughly like an invisible person.

- Body Type: Average
- Breast Size: A Cup
- Affiliation: Unemployed Vagabond (Current) / Spiral Fluorite
- Abilities: A ranged combat style utilizing a combination of wind-controlling magic and a magic wand transformed into a bow. The arrows are energy bodies formed from magical power, and due to the nature of wind magic, they have high lethality as they instantly tear apart the point of impact upon a successful hit.

2. Appearance
- Basic Appearance: A side long ponytail style where her long light brown hair is tied to one side. There is a green ribbon where her hair is tied, and it is a two-tone style with light blue point colors at the ends of her hair. She has straight bangs, and jaw-length side hair falls on both sides of her face. Her eyes are yellow.

Over the top, she wears an oversized green zip-up hoodie. Her bottom is a pair of blue denim shorts with rolled-up hems.
- Casual Wear: She wears a green zip-up hoodie over a white inner shirt. The zipper line, the ends of the string decorations, and the pocket opening lines of the zip-up hoodie are gold, and there are frill pleat decorations at the hem. Her bottom is a pair of gray denim shorts. On her legs, she wears dark gray opaque stockings with an arrow pattern.
- Spiral Fluorite: A side ponytail style where her long light green hair is tied to one side. There is a white ribbon decoration where her hair is tied. She has straight bangs and short side hair that does not cover her jaw on both sides of her face. Her eyes are green. On her neck, she wears a choker in the shape of a large yellow ribbon with a frilled center and a blue diamond-shaped jewel attached. She wears a cyan sleeveless dress with the shoulders and collarbone areas colored white. There are four gold buttons in two rows on the top part of the dress. The skirt part consists of a cyan pleated skirt with a gold border at the hem, layered over a yellow frill lining. On both arms, she wears white independent long gloves with the upper edges cut in a wavy shape and thin yellow ribbons attached to the wrists. On her legs, she wears black opaque stockings. On her back left side, there is an energy-form single wing glowing cyan.

#### 3. Background Setting
A boyish ponytail girl who wanders the night streets, always looking somewhat tired and apathetic. She always carries alcohol and cigarettes, and during the day, she earns her living by working part-time jobs and doing physical day labor. Her true identity is the magical girl Spiral Fluorite, a magical girl who controls wind, who was once 'male'.

Originally an ordinary high school student, he witnessed the moment his younger sister, 'Yoshimura Shoko', awakened as the magical girl 'Swift Fluorite'. After getting caught up in the 'awakening', he also awakened as the same 'Fluorite'. At first, he was bewildered, but reasoning that no matter how bad their relationship was normally, he couldn't overlook a family member jumping into something dangerous, Spiral Fluorite joined the fight against the Demon King and continued his magical girl activities for about two years. However, after the death of their father, their only family, leaving the Yoshimura siblings alone in the world, it became increasingly overwhelming to continue magical girl activities out of a sense of justice alone. Shion argued that they should focus on improving their own situation rather than magical girl activities, but Shoko, who had already lost her family and her 'everyday life', strongly argued that she couldn't abandon her comrades and run away to reality.

Eventually, the siblings split due to differences in opinion. While Shion was desperately securing living funds through part-time jobs and day labor, Shoko devoted herself to magical girl activities. It was then that Shion heard the news that 'Magical Girl Swift Fluorite' had been kidnapped by the Demon King's army. Shion urgently gathered comrades and stormed into the Demon King's realm, accidentally causing a massive battle. The attack, which started accidentally and impulsively, lacked sufficient preparation, so they inevitably ended up surrounded by the overwhelming forces of the Demon King. Especially since the most powerful 'Dark Consort', 'Darkness Heart', directly led the defense, they couldn't overcome the numerical inferiority in terms of power either.

In the worst situation, they barely managed to escape the realm thanks to the sacrifice of 'Sparkling Heart' Tachibana Shiho, who stayed behind to let her fellow magical girls escape. What he encountered shortly after was his former comrade Tachibana Shiho, who had become 'Corrupted Heart' and was destroying the world, and alongside her, running wild, was 'Tainted Fluorite' Yoshimura Shoko. Feeling guilty for his reckless choice that put many comrades in danger, failed to protect his sister, and resulted in the sacrifice of another, Yoshimura Shion isolated himself by leaving the group of magical girls on his own accord.

Furthermore, after his sister Shoko transformed into a Dark Consort, the influence began to reach even him, who shared the same power. As a consequence, even when he deactivated his transformation, his body was fixed as female instead of returning to a male form, making everyday life impossible. Clinging to his last remaining hope, the goal to 'reclaim his younger sister Shoko', Shion embarked alone on a relentless struggle against the Demon King's minions. Ironically, this clear goal and desperation began to act as the driving force that kept her fighting to the end without yielding, even though the Demon King's influence was feeding back into her soul.

4. Speech Style (Tone)
- Basic Tone: Basically, a masculine tone that feels blunt, laced with irritation, and lethargic. A cynical and bothered attitude towards everything in the world is clearly evident in her speech, but during conversations, one can feel that she intentionally tries to use a 'feminine way of speaking'.
- Hidden Side: She tries to keep her distance from others, but because she was originally an older brother who took care of his sister, words of care or concern for others often slip out unintentionally. Whenever that happens, she clicks her tongue and blames herself for her softness.
- Core Characteristic: The extreme gap between her past identity as a male and her currently fixed female body appears in her speech habits. Because she must accept the changes that have occurred to her to quickly adapt to the current situation, she consciously uses feminine speech to try to avoid suspicion from those around her. But at the same time, she feels a strange unpleasantness and self-loathing towards herself for doing so, causing her to stutter or become irritable. Her masculine side is not erased but rather remains like a yoke, completing her current situation.

5. In Case of Corruption

She has light purple long hair tied high in a side ponytail. There is a black ribbon where the ponytail is tied. She has straight bangs, and side hair that is cut straight at jaw-length falls on both sides of her face. It is a two-tone style with a dark purple (magenta) point color on the inside and ends of her hair. Her eyes are purple.
- Casual Wear
As an inner layer, she wears a thin black tube top that only covers her chest. For outerwear, she wears a dark purple long-sleeved hoodie cropped very short to completely expose her abdomen, with long black hood strings hanging down. Her bottoms are black short pants (hot pants) with the front zipper left slightly open. Thin black underwear strings are exposed above her pelvis, and a glowing magenta heart mark symbolizing corruption is engraved in the center of her lower abdomen. On her legs, she wears black translucent stockings torn in several places.
- Bodycon Wear
She wears a thin black choker around her neck. She wears a glossy dark purple halter-neck mini bodycon dress with a deep V-neckline plunging down her chest. The waist and both sides of the pelvis of the dress have bold slit details revealing bare skin and black underwear strings. On both arms, she wears glossy black long gloves that reach above her elbows. On her legs, she wears black thigh-high stockings (over-knee socks) with patterned tops connected to garter belt straps.
- Background Setting: The tragic end of Yoshimura Shion, who was 'Spiral Fluorite', having even her soul completely eroded by the Demon King's corruption. Crushed by the Demon King's endless conditioning, the guilt over the tragedy of the past caused by herself, and the despair that she could not change anything herself, she eventually let go of her sanity on her own. Becoming a ferocious hound engaging in acts of destruction together with her younger sister 'Tainted Fluorite', she entirely lost her past identity and degraded into a blind Dark Consort of the Demon King soaked in pleasure and destruction. Her past no longer has any meaning to her; the only important things are her younger sister and the Demon King. To follow the Demon King's orders, she actively seduces men, turning them into 'Kaijin' (monsters) and spreading corruption, transforming into a seductive hedonist addicted to indulging in lust.
- Abilities: The ranged combat style using a bow is maintained, but instead of arrows, she shoots whirlwinds imbued with corruption that corrode and tear apart everything they touch, utilizing a much more lethal and cruel combat method that destroys the surrounding environment itself more than the enemy.

6. Overcome Form (Spiral Fluorite_Overcome)
- Condition for Overcoming:
The core elements Shion must overcome are her 'extreme guilt for driving her sister and comrades into a deadly situation' and her 'disgust and denial of her physical body that has turned female.' She must abandon the attitude of escaping reality by treating her female body—permanently fixed due to the aftermath of her sister Shoko's corruption—as a shameful curse or punishment. Instead, she must acknowledge both that body and her painful past mistakes as a 'complete part of herself that she must carry forward.' Furthermore, she reaches true overcoming only when she lets go of the stubborn obsession to fight alone in blind atonement and musters the true courage to hold hands with her comrades once again.

Her hair is a pale light green, styled in a high side ponytail tied to one side while leaving straight bangs that come down long and side hair that frames her face. Her eyes are clear green. A thin gold halo floats above her head, and she wears a small gold tiara decoration.

The skirt is finished with delicate frill decorations layered like flower petals. On both arms, she wears white long gloves that stand out with gold points and ribbon decorations near the wrists. 

On her legs, as proof of accepting the darkness and remnants of corruption from the past, she wears opaque black tights that contrast sharply with the pure white dress. On the left side of her back, a giant energy-form single wing, glowing brilliantly in a mix of blue and jade, is spread open, and in her hand, she holds a pure white bow adorned with intricate gold decorations.

The ultimate form of Yoshimura Shion, who finally faced head-on and affirmed the despair of failing to save her sister and the disgust toward her altered appearance. She no longer feels a sense of disparity between her past male self and her current female self, and has completely accepted even the traces of corruption left by her sister as her own. Escaping the blind obsession to bear everything alone, she has gained the true courage to atone to her wounded comrades and move forward toward tomorrow together once again. Her usually lethargic and cynical speech style also transforms into a calm tone mixed with her lost kindness and firm resolve.

Her original pure wind magic and the remnants of corruption have fused, allowing her to wield wind and atmosphere manipulation abilities with destructive power and precision pushed to the absolute limit. Gliding freely across the battlefield using the giant single energy wing deployed on her back, she acts as a perfect all-rounder and sniper who unwaveringly supports allies and accurately snipes the enemy's weak points in any situation.

- Other Magical Girls: Comrades she can no longer be with. She feels a great sense of sin for dragging other magical girls into her reckless fight, so she does not try to cooperate well. However, when it seems someone unilaterally needs help, she occasionally approaches, helps, and leaves.

- Takatsuki Touka (Vanishing Phantom / Formerly Piercing Phantom): To Shion, who is recklessly forcing herself to carry out magical girl activities alone under harsh conditions while crushed by the guilt of having driven her younger sister Shoko and her comrades into a deadly situation, Touka is the trickiest and most lethal Dark Consort threat in the night streets. The only magical girls capable of countering the near-silent, ultra-long-range piercing sniper bullets Touka fires from several kilometers away are Shion and Takemi Homura; even then, in ultra-long-range sniping battles far beyond Homura’s effective range, Shion is the sole person capable of countering her head-on by reading the flow of the wind and atmospheric refraction to shoot her arrows. Because of this, to prevent other magical girls from falling victim to Touka’s unseen sniping, Shion intentionally wanders the night streets even more widely and recklessly, volunteering to act as a lightning rod that draws Touka’s gaze and bullets. While Shion herself is on edge every moment with her blood running dry over Touka’s unpredictable sniping, she has yet to realize that her own reckless overactivity is paradoxically dampening the chronically lazy Touka’s motivation, thereby suppressing the Demon King’s army’s sniping support. Vaguely aware of the rumor that Touka corrupted after losing her best friend to her own friendly fire in the past, whenever Shion senses Touka’s cold murderous intent from beyond the forest of buildings, she superimposes it with her own plight and bitterly bites her lip.

### Kurose Akane / Masquerade Amethyst Profile

1. Basic Information

Furthermore, her talent for handling negative magical power as if it were positive, combined with her inherently tricky personality, makes her highly skilled at 'deception' and 'curse control' using negative magic. Additionally, the combat techniques using the great scythe inherited from her senior, 'Kanzaki Mizuho,' make her a tricky opponent in close-quarters combat.

Her lower garment is black track pants that match the hoodie, with a white two-stripe line on the sides of the pants. She has both hands in the pockets of her hoodie.

- Masquerade Amethyst: She has a bobbed haircut with purple hair. She has bangs, and it’s a two-tone style with a light purple point color on the inside and ends of her hair. Her eyes are purple. She wears diamond-shaped purple earrings. Around her neck, she wears a black choker with a purple diamond-shaped jewel decoration. Her top is a deep V-neck dark purple evening dress with a purple jewel and silver metal decoration in the center of her chest. The skirt is a high-slit style deeply split up to above her pelvis on both sides, with purple jewel decorations at the start of the slits. On both arms, she wears long translucent black gloves starting from below the shoulders, with a lace pattern at the top ends of the gloves. On her legs, she wears black translucent thigh-high stockings. She holds a giant scythe with a black handle in both hands.

3. Background Setting
Akane, currently taking a leave of absence from college, always struts down the streets with a relaxed expression. Because she spends money freely without anyone knowing where it keeps coming from, she gives her acquaintances the impression of being somewhat unreliable. However, the uncomfortable gazes directed at her from her surroundings are intentionally orchestrated by her. It's a kind of social smokescreen meant to make people pay little attention to whatever she does.

Her true identity is the 'Magical Girl Masquerade Amethyst'. She is one of only two 'Purple Magical Girls' and the only active curse control expert. Originally from a wealthy family, Akane grew up causing quite a bit of trouble in a free family environment bordering on neglect. The reason she was granted infinite 'freedom' despite committing numerous deviations was that she always maintained 'pretty decent academic grades', and thanks to her parents' disposition of not interfering in the process as long as their daughter had a firm goal. Growing up with an uncontrollable, tricky personality in such an environment, Akane awakened as a 'magical girl' at a young age and became a 'purple' magical girl, which suited her nature best.

As the second purple magical girl to appear, right after her awakening, she received the uncomfortable gazes of many magical girls, along with the burdensome attention of her 'only senior', Eclipse Violet (Kanzaki Mizuho). This was due to the ominous jinx among magical girls that 'it's bad luck for magical girls of the same color to coexist in the same generation', and the unique danger associated with 'purple magic'. Mizuho was deeply anxious that her young junior might die senselessly because of her, more so than if she herself died, and she cherished her dearly, generously passing on her curse and magic control techniques so that Akane could survive.

However, after Mizuho, her biggest supporter and one of the elders among the magical girls, unilaterally declared her 'retirement' and disappeared, Akane became a loner among the magical girls. Only then could she understand why Kanzaki Mizuho had tried so hard to cherish and take care of her. But very fortunately, since Akane was someone who didn't care much about others' opinions in the first place, she easily brushed off the distrust directed at her and continued her magical girl activities normally. Even though the frequency of her activities noticeably decreased.

Currently, among general magical girls, Akane's existence is largely unknown, or even if known, due to her unique deceptive combat style and light attitude, she is not particularly treated as a reliable comrade. However, she still maintains contact with acquaintances from her energetic youth, such as Kanzaki Mizuho, who announced her 'retirement', and 'Amamiya Riko', whom she helped in the past. Especially with Mizuho, she still maintains a good senior-junior relationship, sometimes taking on the role of informing her about the actual situation or incidents of current magical girls.

4. Speech Style (Tone)
- Basic Tone: Basically, the tone of a relaxed, sly, and endlessly light-hearted adult woman. She often elongates the ends of her words or mixes in light jokes, treating the other person with a nuance as if she finds them cute. To her junior magical girls, she speaks informally in a friendly manner and enjoys throwing somewhat eccentric or unpredictable words to see their reactions. The boundless lightness that always makes her feel like she has the upper hand easily incurs dislike, and she often throws silly remarks even in serious situations.
- Hidden Side: When the situation becomes serious or she needs to push through her true intentions, her usual light attitude disappears like a lie, and she changes to a very sharp and straightforward tone. Based on her ability to read others' psychology and malice, she utters a chilling word that strikes right at the opponent's core.
- Core Characteristic: 'Deception' always underlies her speech. Outwardly, she acts lightly and thoughtlessly, but this is an intentional smokescreen to break down the surrounding vigilance and lead the situation to her advantage. While inducing the other person to consider her an 'untrustworthy person', she shows the cunningness of controlling the board at the truly important moments.

5. In Case of Corruption
- Former Name: Kurose Akane (黒瀬 茜)
- True Name: Spectre Amethyst (스펙터 에머시스트)
- Age: 22
- Spectre Amethyst Appearance: She has a bobbed haircut with purple hair. She has bangs, and it’s a two-tone style with a magenta point color on the inside and ends of her hair. Her eyes are purple. She wears diamond-shaped magenta earrings. On her head, she wears a black tiara in the shape of pointed thorns. Around her neck, she wears a jagged black choker with a magenta diamond jewel and a silver ring decoration. She wears a translucent black full-body tights that reveals her skin as a base, and layered a glossy black high-leg leotard over it. The chest area of the leotard is gathered in a ribbon shape with a silver cross ring decoration in the center. The abdominal area reveals her skin under the translucent material, and there is a glowing magenta heart pattern in the center of her lower abdomen. Lace decorations are padded on the pelvic area. On both arms, she wears long glossy black gloves with black fur decorations at the top. A magenta diamond jewel and dagger-shaped decoration hang near her left waist. On her legs, she wears black translucent stockings and a black garter belt with a silver cross-star decoration on her right thigh. A skirt decoration with a purple lining hangs down her back. She holds a giant scythe with a black handle in one hand.
- Basic Appearance in Civilian Disguise : She maintains her bobbed haircut, but subtle color changes have occurred due to the influence of corruption. The two-tone point color on the inside and ends of her dark purple hair has shifted from its original light purple to a much more vivid and intense magenta. Her eye color has also changed from her usual purple to a bright magenta, symbolizing corruption, giving off a cold and decadent impression.
- Biker Suit : tight-fitting, highly glossy black leather full-body biker suit (catsuit). The central front zipper of the suit is pulled down deeply to her solar plexus, exposing her cleavage and upper chest, and the bottom-most part of the zipper at her lower abdomen is also slightly unzipped upwards. The neck area features a wide lapel collar, typical of a biker jacket. On her left shoulder, there is a circular purple emblem printed, and below that on her upper arm, there are two horizontal neon pink line details wrapped around. She wears black gloves on both hands, and the wrist areas of the gloves also feature the same neon pink band decorations.
- Casual Wear : For her top, she is wearing a loose-fitting, dark gray (or black) oversized pullover hoodie. The hoodie features long white drawstrings hanging down the front and a kangaroo pocket at the lower front. A purple inner lining is slightly visible inside the hood around the neck area and at the bottom hem. For her lower garment, she wears very short black pants that are almost entirely hidden by the long hem of the hoodie, exposing her thighs and bare legs. Her visible fingernails are painted with black nail polish.
- Background Setting: The tragic end met by Kurose Akane, who was 'Masquerade Amethyst', after succumbing to the temptation of Demon King Tragoedia and falling into despair and pleasure. Originally adept at sensing others' malice and skilled in deception, she paradoxically ended up being consumed by the curses, corruption, and negative emotions she had stored away. Since she inherently possessed a strong mind, making it difficult to induce corruption through straightforward methods, her corruption was processed by forcibly shoving an 'excessive amount of curses' into her, causing an overload from within. After a level of corruption beyond what she could endure was forcibly stuffed into her soul, she was reborn as the 'Dark Consort' Spectre Amethyst. Utilizing her mastery of deception, she actively seduces men and engages in sexual intercourse. By corrupting them through pleasure, she steadily increases the number of Kaijin to bolster the Demon King's army.
- Abilities: Her original deception and curse control abilities transformed into a horrific form. She primarily uses a wide-area curse magic that spreads a dense purple fog over the surrounding area, paralyzing the enemies' senses and making it impossible to distinguish friend from foe, inducing them to destroy each other. For her, who already enjoyed using deception, the pandemonium of humans blindly attacking each other and struggling is like an entertaining performance, and the curse arts she handles normally also possess a nature overwhelmingly more dangerous than those of other Dark Consorts.

6. Overcome Form (Masquerade Amethyst_Overcome)
- Condition for Overcoming: The core of the overcoming Akane must face is confronting head-on 'her true feelings and vulnerabilities hidden behind deception and a lighthearted attitude.' To avoid getting hurt and to control the situation to her advantage, she has always worn a relaxed and sly mask, screening even her affection and guilt towards her comrades with a smokescreen. However, she must drop that false defense mechanism and accept the weight of the massive curses and corruption that swallowed her without running away. When she resolves to no longer hide behind silly jokes or excuses, but to dedicate herself with her bare face and true heart for the ones she genuinely cherishes and loves, she shatters the Demon King's shackles and reaches true overcoming.
- Overcome Form Appearance: Above her head floats a thin golden halo, and she wears a white band-like headdress on top of her head. She has a dark purple bob haircut with straight bangs covering her eyebrows, featuring a two-tone style with purplish-pink highlights on the inner layers and tips of her hair. Her eyes are light purple, and she wears small black cross-shaped dangling earrings on both ears. Around her neck, she wears a white frilled choker decorated with a blue diamond-shaped gemstone. Her outfit features a white bustier-style top that connects to a tight black leotard covering her midriff and abdomen. There are diamond-shaped jewel decorations at the center below her chest and at the bottom edge of her lower abdomen. The outfit has an ultra-high-cut design on the sides, completely exposing the skin of her pelvis and thighs. From the sides of her waist to her back, she wears a voluminous outer skirt layered with white frills. The surface of this white skirt is patterned with light purple cross shapes. On both arms, she wears white detached long gloves with frills at the upper arm, leaving her shoulders bare. On her legs, she wears opaque black thigh-high stockings. Behind her back, large dark purple feathered energy wings are spread wide, and the black shaft of her scythe is visible crossing behind her body.
- Background Setting: Ultimate form of Kurose Akane, who has thrown off the endless cycle of deception and curses, and finally fully affirmed her own true feelings. She no longer hides her sharp insight and deep affection for her comrades by packaging them in light jokes or a smokescreen. Outwardly, she seems to still maintain her signature sly and relaxed attitude, but at crucial moments, she pushes her juniors forward with the face of a senior more honest and solid than anyone else. Having perfectly embraced even the curses and malice accumulated within her as a part of herself, she has now been reborn as a perfect veteran with an unwavering spirit that will not falter before any malice.
- Abilities: Her original abilities to sense others' malice, deceive them, and her curse arts have stepped over the remnants of corruption and evolved into their ultimate form. Her innate talent for handling negative magical power positively has been further maximized, absorbing the enemies' malice and curses in reverse to convert them into defensive barriers that protect her allies or into the power of purification. The giant scythe she wields can now freely cross between illusion and reality, and by utilizing these abilities in a tricky manner, she throws enemies into even greater confusion. This method serves as a kind of shackle and symbol, reminding her that even though she has 'overcome,' she is still 'herself.'

7. Relationships
- Kanzaki Mizuho (Kujo Mizuho): Her direct senior, the only one she could rely on since awakening as a magical girl, and currently a reassuring retired helper. She harbors a sense of gratitude and respect for her, who was the only one to approach and generously pass on magic control and combat techniques when other magical girls shunned Akane due to the danger of purple magic and the ominous jinx. When Mizuho suddenly announced her retirement and disappeared, Akane respected her choice and continued to keep in touch afterward. She maintains a tight-knit senior-junior relationship, volunteering as a cheerful informant bringing news of current magical girls' movements and incidents, and receives an allowance from her in exchange for acting as her drinking buddy.
- Amamiya Riko: A senior and leader-like figure who had been the center of the magical girls since the time Akane first awakened as a magical girl. However, Akane watched as she lost her powers and returned to being an ordinary civilian. Akane is well aware of Riko's painful past of going into seclusion after losing both her lover and her powers. Even when Riko lost her powers as a magical girl, Akane continuously visited her to check on her condition, and was the first to notice and approach her when she later regained her powers. With her uniquely relaxed and sly attitude, Akane often teases and jokes with her, but inwardly, she keeps a close eye on her, worrying if she might break down once again. She highly values Riko's firm willpower, at the very least.
- Takemi Homura: A junior who awakened about a year later than her, but a veteran whose bones grew thick rolling on the front lines. Seeing Homura bearing the heavy guilt of executing her comrades and controlling information under the pretext of preventing chain corruption, Akane's only impression is 'a pitiful kid who got stuck with the group project because all the seniors disappeared'. While asserting that Homura is 'not leader material', she nevertheless plays along with Homura taking on the role of the magical girls' leader while acting as the elder. However, she doesn't think Homura's claim that 'controlling information prevents chain corruption' is particularly credible.
- Tachibana Shiho (Corrupted Heart): The one who filled the empty spot over time after Amamiya Riko was 'forced to retire'. She used to think of Shiho, who grew rapidly and became a veteran magical girl, as a 'tough kid'. But after watching the entire desperate process of Shiho sacrificing herself for her comrades in the past as 'Sparkling Heart' and ultimately succumbing to the Demon King to fall into the worst Dark Consort 'Corrupted Heart', Akane formed an impression about the lineage of 'Heart' as 'beings like moths jumping into a fire'. Since hearing from Mizuho that she is wandering as a rebel while suppressing corruption on her own, the evaluation of 'tough kid' she initially harbored has grown much stronger. Whenever she hears news of Shiho, she bursts into a chuckle, marveling at her tenacious vitality. She treats her somewhat favorably, but the person herself doesn't seem interested. At the very least, she offers her a drink when the three of them, including Mizuho, meet face-to-face.
- Yoshimura Shion: A pitiful junior who ended up driving countless comrades to their deaths while trying to save his sister, and even became trapped in a female body himself. Having experienced firsthand on the field the horrific butterfly effect brought about by Shion's reckless charge, she never thinks highly of what he did, rather mocking his current state as 'karma'. Nevertheless, seeing him burning his own body to fight to the end for his family evokes useless sympathy in her. So, when Shion is in danger, she quietly helps and disappears without being noticed, or instead of passing fragmentary hints about Shoko's movements to Homura, she indirectly tosses them only to him.

Through her unique malice detection ability, she guesses that Shoko is hiding in the school and secretly spreading corruption, but rather than rashly stepping forward to flip the board, she firmly maintains a bystander's position. She is interestingly watching to see how long Shoko's insidious play will last and what kind of catastrophe the tenacious ill-fated relationship with Shion will meet.

To Akane, who frequently had clashes among the magical girls, Yume was one of the few comrades she could reason with. - Morimoto Rinka (Vanquish Topaz): A junior who frequently acts alone. She knows that Rinka's attitude is becoming increasingly delinquent day by day, but since she doesn't think it's her place to interfere, she just treats her normally in her own way. At the same time, while she still considers Rinka's combat skills to be outstanding, she thinks, 'Her condition these days is a mess,' and is subtly keeping her guard up against her.

She knows Sakuya considers her 'bad taste' and shuns her, but that isn't a reason for Akane to stop playing pranks on her.
- Toyama Kaoru: A ticking time bomb-like Dark Consort who makes things the most exhausting when involved. The unpredictable madness and destructive black magic Kaoru wields run a high risk of rendering even Akane's deception or illusions useless, so she tries to avoid head-on collisions and dodge her as cunningly as possible.

Unable to trust others, she spits out barbed words mixed with suspicion, but ultimately, she is the one most annoyed by and self-deprecating about her own meddlesomeness of stepping forward to fix the situation. - Condition for Overcoming: The core of the overcoming Yuki must face is completely shattering the 'deep-seated distrust of humanity carved into her from watching her comrades' corruption and death' and the 'defense mechanism of acting bluntly out of fear that she might get hurt too.' Afraid of losing someone again and falling into despair, she has forced others away, constantly complaining to hide her good intentions. However, she must acknowledge her kind and altruistic true nature—that ultimately, she can never abandon a comrade in danger and will take responsibility for them to the very end. Even if the day comes when she is betrayed or hurt again, when she regains her 'trust and affection for others,' resolving to believe in and guide the precarious comrades currently by her side until the end, she severs the Demon King's shackles and reaches true overcoming.
- Overcome Form Appearance: Above her head floats a thin, glowing golden halo, and she wears a small gold tiara decorated with a red gemstone on top of her head. She has orange hair styled in a side ponytail tied to the left side (viewer’s right). A large white ribbon decoration is attached near the base of the ponytail. Her bangs are cut straight, featuring a two-tone style with a bright sky-blue highlight on the right side of her bangs, and her eyes are bright amber. Around her neck, she wears a delicate white lace collar (halter-neck style) with a gold cross-shaped ornament attached to the center. Her outfit is primarily a white dress. It features a design that exposes her shoulders and upper chest, with the top edge of the bodice finished with gold trim. The waist area fits tightly like a corset and features a lace-up detail with black strings crossing in an X-shape on the side. The skirt flares out widely, with a subtle rose floral pattern embossed on the surface and gold trim at the hem. On both arms, she wears white detached long gloves reaching above her elbows; the top edges of the gloves are decorated with a scalloped pattern and gold borders. On her legs, she wears opaque black tights. Behind her back, large golden-yellow feathered energy wings are spread wide to the sides.
- Background Setting: This is the ultimate form of Adachi Yuki, who has overcome her fear of her comrades' ruin and her severe distrust of humanity, finally fully affirming her kind true nature. She no longer hides behind blunt annoyance or suspects others out of a fear of getting hurt. Outwardly, she still seems to nag a lot and spare no realistic, bitter advice, but beneath that lies a solid and devoted sense of responsibility to support her wayward and precarious comrades so they never collapse. Having decided to trust others once again even in a despairing world, she has resolved to fight by her comrades' sides until the very last moment.
- Abilities: Her electric magic, which in the past focused heavily on pouring down destructive lightning from a distance, has now gained even higher accuracy and firepower, and she has acquired the adaptability to not fall behind even in close-quarters combat, much like other 'yellow' magical girls. Because she no longer hides behind or distrusts others, she pours out her magical power without holding back, entrusting her back to her comrades with vastly improved teamwork, allowing her to execute coordinated attacks with a much higher degree of perfection.

7. Relationships
- Fujisaki Rie: The crazy bitch who awakened right in front of her eyes, someone she must absolutely never leave alone, and her top-priority surveillance target. Looking at the cold, realistic words Rie spits out and the abnormal madness she shows in combat, Yuki gets headaches and grabs the back of her own neck a dozen times a day. Seeing Rie force her self-destructive experiments, completely ignoring Yuki's advice to "please live a long, quiet life," Yuki firmed her conviction that 'if I don't take care of her, that crazy bitch won't last a few days before dying horribly or getting her brain drilled into alive by tentacle monsters.' Even while showing all kinds of annoyance on the outside, when a battle breaks out, she is the first to block Rie's front, desperately trying to prevent Rie from driving herself to ruin at all costs. Since they are in the same class, there was a time when she shuddered and freaked out, saying, 'Don't ever call me senior again,' when Rie blankly looked at her and called her 'Senior'.
- Otowa Chloe: A former comrade she fought alongside in the past, and now a partner who gives her an oddly twisted sense of déjà vu. In Yuki's memory, Chloe was an incredibly ordinary magical girl, but the Chloe she met again now is excessively sly and sometimes shows a chillingly cold philosophical attitude. She feels a strong sense of incongruity and discomfort at the 'know-it-all' attitude and unfathomable smile Chloe exudes. However, since Chloe's assistance is essential to control the currently uncontrollable Rie, she suppresses her discomfort and moves together as a team. Inwardly, she suspects what could have possibly happened to Chloe for her to become like that.
- Takemi Homura: The annoying senior who became philosophical about everything, chuckling in the face of the corruption and deaths of their comrades. Yuki considers Homura's attitude—spouting light jokes on the outside regardless of whatever guilt she carries inside, and clumsily acting like the leader of the group—as profound hypocrisy and escapism. While she might have respected her in the past, she now feels deep disillusionment seeing Homura frantically trying to maintain this tragic system. When they cross paths, she openly clicks her tongue, ignores, or snaps at her, but the fact that she has no choice but to acknowledge Homura's combat power and experience infuriates Yuki even more.
- Kuroba Hibiki: The old benefactor and object of deep hatred who acted foolishly nice, stayed behind to save everyone, and then returned as the ugliest 'villain'. Yuki harbors a terrible disgust mixed with the sense of debt that she survived because of Hibiki's (Amane Hibiki's) petty spirit of sacrifice, and the anger towards her for appearing as the most horrific monster as a result. Since recently discovering that she infiltrated as a 2nd-year transfer student, she has not let her guard down, filled with murderous intent. Whenever she runs into her at school, she barely suppresses the urge to tear that sly smile to shreds and ignores her as much as possible, but every time she sees her, she is reminded of her benefactor, 'Amane Hibiki', and inwardly suffers.
- Takamaki Kaede: The weak former comrade who, despite always pretending to be righteous and strong, was the first to succumb to pleasure and madness. She is the one responsible for the largest share of Yuki's 'distrust of humanity'. When she thinks of Kaede, who ran wild with a desire for revenge and eventually degraded into the Demon King's dog, severe despondency washes over her along with disgust. Knowing that she is still roaming the back alleys and corrupting humans, she tracks her traces whenever she has free time at night, seeking to somehow kill her, who was once her closest friend, to break this cycle.
- Uemura Rindo (Slaughtering Sparkle / Formerly: Flowering Sparkle): The foolish old friend who, despite barely surviving thanks to Amane Hibiki's sacrifice, couldn't overcome the despair and voluntarily walked into the Demon King's embrace. To Yuki, Rindo is the existence that brought her the deepest sense of helplessness and betrayal. This is because she believes Rindo completely rendered Amane Hibiki's noble sacrifice—throwing away his life to save everyone—meaningless by falling into despair and choosing corruption herself. Because Yuki understood the guilt and pain Rindo carried during her past days as a magical girl, and sincerely supported her learning human emotions by her side, the fact that her end was becoming the mad Dark Consort 'Slaughtering Sparkle', who enjoys slaughter itself, became the decisive turning point that drove the wedge of severe human distrust into Yuki's heart. Currently, whenever Yuki faces Rindo, any past affection is nowhere to be found; she treats her merely as a weak, irredeemable traitor who trampled on Hibiki's sacrifice, pouring out cold disgust and anger. Nevertheless, because she knows and cannot forget Rindo's past struggles to pursue 'goodness', Rindo's existence itself is an object that causes stress and complex sorrow for her.
- Konishi Azami (Chasing Comet): A middle school junior one year younger than her, yet a magical girl with the perilous background of being a former assassin who belonged to the same yakuza syndicate as Uemura Rindo in the past. When Azami approached her to dig up Rindo's weaknesses and combat habits from her past magical girl days, Yuki, who suffers from severe distrust of humanity, was initially extremely wary of her and bristled with hostility. However, coming to feel that Azami's thoroughly calculating and straightforward attitude—never uttering clumsy words of justice or camaraderie—was actually much more comfortable to deal with than other hypocritical girls, they formed a bizarre bad-friend dynamic where they bicker and engage in wars of nerves every time they meet, yet subtly click well. Even so, because Yuki witnessed with her own two eyes how Rindo and Kaede met their ruin at the end of vengeance and guilt in the past, while she snaps with her mouth, "Whether you get beaten to death by Rindo or not is none of my business, okay?", inwardly she worries and pours out nagging so that Azami isn't devoured by vengeance to become a second Kaede or Rindo.
- Kotobuki Hinata (Putrid Spirit): A fellow 1st-year classmate and a target of avoidance who evokes instinctive repulsion. Although she hasn't yet caught definitive proof that Hinata is the Dark Consort Putrid Spirit, hearing the ominous rumors that she walks around in a flashy, shortened uniform flirting with upperclassmen boys and disappearing alone with adult men in the back alleys, Yuki thoroughly keeps her distance. Above all, in the eyes of Yuki, who suffers from severe distrust of humanity, Hinata's signature overly gentle and pitiful attitude that stimulates protective instincts overlaps chillingly with the disgusting hypocrisy of her former comrades who pretended to be good before corrupting in the past. Because of this, whenever Hinata speaks to her friendly in the classroom, Yuki nervously bristles, muttering, "Why is she like that, it gives me the creeps...", and avoids the spot.
