### Konishi Azami / Chasing Comet Profile

1. Basic Information
- Name: Konishi Azami (코니시 아자미 / 小西 薊)
- Magical Girl Name: Chasing Comet (체이싱 코맷)
- Age: 15
- Gender: Female
- Body Type: Skinny, flat body type with almost no curves
- Breast Size: AA Cup
- Affiliation: 3rd-year middle school student / Magical Girl Chasing Comet / Former Yakuza Syndicate Assassin
- Abilities: Marksmanship that compresses and fires high-firepower starlight in the form of magical bullets from two large automatic pistols, combined with ultra-close-quarters akimbo Gun Kata integrating martial arts acquired during her days as an assassin. She loads her bullets with Star magical power, which possesses high penetration and the power to annihilate the point of impact. Not only can she form a barrage like a meteor shower from a distance to suppress enemies, but she also wields cold-blooded and efficient killing techniques, burrowing into the enemy's space to pour out point-blank shots from their blind spots.

2. Appearance
- Basic Appearance: She has dark brown hair with straight bangs covering her eyebrows. Her hair is loosely tied below her ears into low twintails that fall past her collarbones, and she wears a silver bobby pin on the left side of her hair. Her eyes are dark grayish-brown, and she has a skinny, flat body type with almost no curves.
- School Uniform: Over the lower half of her face, she wears a black fabric mask decorated with gold floral patterns on both sides, completely covering her nose and mouth. For her uniform, she wears a dark charcoal sailor-style top with double white stripes along the collar edges, a small circular white emblem at the center of the chest panel, and a large white scarf tied in a bow at the front. Over the sailor uniform, she wears an unzipped, oversized red windbreaker jacket featuring black snap buttons and ribbed cuffs. Her lower garment is a matching dark charcoal pleated skirt, and black backpack straps are visible over her shoulders.
Casual Wear: On her head, she wears a plain black baseball cap. For her top, she wears a loose-fitting, oversized gray long-sleeved pullover hoodie featuring black drawstrings hanging down the front and a front kangaroo pocket. Her lower garment is a pair of extremely short, high-gloss black leather hot pants with two vertical white stripes along both sides, leaving her legs bare. Around her upper right thigh, she wears a double-strapped black leather garter band fastened with small silver buckles.
- Magical Girl Outfit: She has a silver-white bob haircut with straight bangs, featuring a pink streak on the right side of her bangs and dark navy and purple secret two-tone highlights on the inner layers. Extending from the back of her hair are two long, thin twintail strands that transition in a gradient from navy to sky-blue towards the tips. On top of her head, she wears a silver tiara embedded with a blue gemstone in the center, and a wing-shaped silver hairpin on the left side of her hair. Her eyes are light purple. Around her neck, she wears a high-neck dark navy muffler collar patterned with starlight that completely covers the lower half of her face up to her nose. Beneath the collar, at her upper chest, sits a blue ribbon tie centered with a gold eight-pointed star ornament. Her top is a form-fitting white long-sleeved jacket featuring gold laurel-like motifs on the outer upper arms and flared cuffs finished with gold trim and blue frills. Over her abdomen, she wears a glossy black corset vest with four gold buttons, which opens at the center to reveal the white inner jacket adorned with gold cross-star studs. Hanging down her back are long dark navy muffler tails patterned with constellations. Her lower garment is a pleated miniskirt featuring a night-sky gradient shifting from dark navy to bright sky-blue, decorated with gold star motifs and layered over a white ruffled underskirt. On her legs, she wears semi-translucent white tights with scalloped top edges, paired with white knee-high boots accented with gold trim and blue panels. Wearing blue and white gloves on both hands, she dual-wields large silver-white automatic pistols decorated with blue panels and gold cross-star emblems along the barrels.

3. Background Setting
An orphan girl from the Kansai region who lost her parents at a young age. An elderly local dignitary who had ties to her deceased parents volunteered to be her guardian and took her in as his adopted daughter. However, the old man's true identity was the boss of a yakuza syndicate that ruled the underworld. Azami grew up receiving the Boss's special favor within the organization, but at the same time, she was raised as an assassin who handled the underworld's dirty work to repay his grace. Despite being only a middle schooler, she Already had a track record of eliminating targets several times, dedicating absolute loyalty to the Boss who took her in.

She had an adoptive older sister named Uemura Rindo, who was raised in the same syndicate. Although Rindo was close to an emotionless killing machine, Azami relied on and trusted her as an older sister in her own way. However, one day, Rindo suddenly attacked the entire organization, ruthlessly slaughtering all the members and even the Boss. Having lost both the Boss and her home without even knowing why, Azami was left alone to inherit the massive fortune the Boss left behind.

For the first time, pitch-black hatred and a desire for revenge against Rindo took root inside Azami. To keep the strangely gentle order the Boss gave her in life—to attend school regularly and get an ordinary diploma—she mechanically commuted between her empty mansion and her middle school, craving only the day she would kill Rindo. Then one day, as if responding to her intense obsession, she awakened as the Star-attribute magical girl, Chasing Comet.

Having never once thought of herself as righteous in her entire life, Azami found it utterly absurd that a blood-stained assassin like herself was chosen for such a childish game. To the magical girls who first contacted her, she coldly drew a line, stating she had zero intention of hanging out with apostles of justice like them and that she would use this power solely to blow a hole through Uemura Rindo's head. However, she heard the ridiculous truth from the magical girls: the reason Rindo slaughtered the organization was that she had awakened to guilt after becoming the magical girl Flowering Sparkle, and she had now fallen into despair and degenerated into the Demon King's Dark Consort, Slaughtering Sparkle. Ultimately, making the thoroughly calculating judgment that acting alongside the magical girl group would make it much easier to track down Rindo's whereabouts and end her life, Azami reluctantly decided to play along with them and joined the united front.

4. Speech Style (Tone)
- Basic Tone: She explicitly speaks in a Kansai dialect (represented as Southeastern/Busan dialect in Korean) with a languid yet chilling intonation. Normally, she speaks in a relaxed voice as if everything is a bother, but rough and bloody underworld slang naturally mixes into her choice of words.
- Hidden Side: When topics related to Uemura Rindo come up, or when a battle intensifies and her true nature as an assassin awakens, the intonation of her dialect sinks even lower and colder. Without any emotional fluctuation, she calmly aims for the opponent's vitals or discusses cruel methods of execution, nonchalantly displaying a murderous intent that would horrify ordinary magical girls.
- Core Characteristic: A speech style centered around thorough pragmatism and vengeance, without a shred of justice or sense of duty. She treats magical girl activities as a childish game or a bothersome chore, maintaining a hollow and dry attitude as if she has no lingering attachment to life outside of her two goals: the Boss's final wish and her revenge. Surprisingly, she is easily swayed by unconditional goodwill offered by others; blushing furiously and getting annoyed, she has a soft spot where she cannot refuse their kindness.

5. In Case of Corruption
- Former Name: Konishi Azami
- True Name: Decayed Comet (디케이드 코맷)
- Age: 15
- Corrupted Magical Girl Outfit: She has a purplish silver-white bob haircut with straight bangs, featuring a magenta streak on the right side of her bangs and dark purple secret two-tone highlights on the inner layers. Extending from the back of her hair are two long, thin twintail strands in purple and white, glittering with stardust motifs. On her head, she wears a sharp, pointed black tiara, and an angled silver hairpin on the left side. Her eyes are vivid magenta with concentric ring patterns, and she wears purple cross-star drop earrings on both ears. Around her neck, she wears a glossy black high-neck choker embedded with magenta diamond-shaped jewels, from which thin black leather straps cross in an X-shape over her upper chest. Her base outfit is a full-body, semi-translucent black sheer bodysuit that explicitly reveals her skin tone and curves underneath. Over the sheer suit, she wears a glossy black high-leg leotard featuring a short silver zipper at the center of the bust and a large diamond-shaped cutout exposing her entire sheer-covered midriff. Through the sheer fabric on her lower abdomen, a brightly glowing magenta heart-shaped crest of corruption is clearly visible. Attached to the sides of her hips are short, voluminous purple ruffled skirt decorations. On both arms, she wears glossy black long gloves adorned with black bows at the upper edges and thick cuffs at the wrists. On her legs, she wears glossy black thigh-high boots featuring vertical front zippers and silver heart-shaped frames embedded with magenta heart gems at the top edges. In both hands, she dual-wields large black automatic pistols accented with glowing purple lines.
- Basic Appearance in Civilian Disguise: She has light purple hair with straight bangs covering her eyebrows. Her hair is loosely tied below her ears with thick black ring hair ties into low twintails, featuring vivid pink secret two-tone highlights on the inner layers, and she wears a silver bobby pin on the left side. Her eyes are vivid magenta with concentric ring patterns in the irises, and she has a skinny, flat body type with almost no curves.
- Hoodie Wear: She wears an oversized dark charcoal zip-up hoodie directly over her bare skin without any bra or inner shirt underneath. The purple front zipper is pulled all the way down to her lower abdomen, creating a deep vertical opening that explicitly exposes the bare skin of her flat chest, sternum, and midriff. The long hem of the hoodie completely covers her lower garments in a bottomless style, leaving her bare thighs exposed underneath.
- Casual Wear: For her top, she wears a loose-fitting, plain black short-sleeved crew-neck t-shirt. Her lower garment is a pair of tight-fitting black skinny jeans featuring horizontal ripped details on the front of both thighs that expose her skin underneath.
- Background Setting: The tragic end where even her sole driving force in life—revenge—was meaninglessly frustrated, causing her to succumb to Demon King Tragoedia. Into her inner self, which had become completely empty after losing the Boss, the Demon King reigned as a new master, filling the void with endless pleasure and a justification for slaughter. After her corruption, she replaced the blind loyalty she once dedicated to the Boss with twisted obedience toward the Demon King, degenerating into the Demon King's cold-blooded executioner, Decayed Comet, who roams the blood-soaked battlefield just like her former adoptive sister, Rindo. To expand the Demon King's forces, she wanders the night streets seducing naive men, performing the act of shattering their sanity and turning them into Kaijin through sexual exploitation and sadistic pleasure like a mechanical game without a shred of guilt.
- Abilities: The destructive nature latent within her Star magic has been maximized. The purple magical bullets fired from her black pistols ignore physical trajectories to home in on and pierce the target's vitals, eroding the target from the point of impact and gradually annihilating them.

6. Overcome Form (Chasing Comet_Overcome)
- Condition for Overcoming: The core of the overcoming Azami must face is confronting her self-denial—thinking 'she exists only to repay the Boss's grace and complete her revenge'—and the loneliness hidden behind the sense of loss from being betrayed by Rindo. Even after learning that Rindo slaughtered the syndicate due to her petty sense of justice as a magical girl, Azami thoroughly denied Rindo's agony and used only hatred as her fuel so that she wouldn't waver. However, when she realizes that the final order the Boss left her was not revenge, but a warm consideration for her to live as an ordinary student, and when she fully accepts her blood-stained past karma and her love-hate feelings toward Rindo as a part of herself—resolving to live for tomorrow by her own will as Konishi Azami rather than as someone's tool—she reaches true overcoming.
- Overcome Form Appearance: Above her head floats a flat, disc-shaped silver halo, and she wears a silver tiara embedded with a blue gemstone in the center. She has a silver-white bob haircut with a magenta streak in her bangs, dark navy inner two-tone highlights, and a wing-shaped silver hairpin on the left side. The two long, thin twintail strands extending from her back hair feature magenta highlights near the base before transitioning into a starry night-sky gradient of navy and sky-blue. Her eyes are light purple with concentric ring patterns. Her outfit maintains the same structural design as her pre-corruption magical girl attire. Below the starlight-patterned dark navy high-neck muffler covering the lower half of her face, she wears a two-tone blue and sky-blue ribbon tie centered with a gold eight-pointed star ornament. Over a white long-sleeved jacket with gold motifs on the upper arms, she wears a glossy black corset vest detailed with gold buttons and cross-star studs. The sleeves end in gold trim and blue ruffled cuffs. Her lower garment is a pleated miniskirt with a navy-to-sky-blue gradient and gold star patterns, layered over a white ruffled underskirt. Over semi-translucent white tights, she wears white thigh-high boots with scalloped top edges, gold trim, and sky-blue accents. Behind her back, giant feathered energy wings spread wide; the upper edges are framed with gold armor-like trim, while the wings themselves transition from a purple and blue starry nebula pattern into semi-translucent sky-blue feathers. Wearing white and blue gloves, she dual-wields large silver-white automatic pistols adorned with blue panels and gold cross-star emblems.
- Background Setting: This is the ultimate form of Konishi Azami, who has escaped the narrow prison of past ghosts and vengeance, resolving to live her own life. Without erasing the karma of the murders she committed as an assassin or her resentment toward her adoptive sister, she embraces all that darkness and moves forward. Outwardly, she still spits out a prickly Kansai dialect and grumbles that she hates playing the apostle of justice, but she has now been reborn as a reliable supporter who unhesitatingly pulls the trigger to protect the ordinary daily life the Boss wished for, and the lives of the comrades she came to know within that daily life.
- Abilities: Her combat ability, which was already complete from the beginning, has become much more proficient than before, and as she has grown slightly more accustomed to fighting in coordination with her teammates, her ability to match teamwork has improved. Her ability to handle Star magic has developed in a direction that extremely highlights its unique destructive power, allowing her to intricately and lethally scatter Star-powered magical bullets imbued with the attribute of annihilation to suppress enemies.

7. Relationships
- Uemura Rindo: Her adoptive older sister who once served the Boss and worked as an assassin in the same syndicate, and currently the target of revenge whom Azami hates the most. Not only is she dumbfounded that the sister she trusted and relied on in her own way slaughtered the Boss and the syndicate members overnight and vanished, but she is also appalled that the reason behind it was guilt as a magical girl. Furthermore, upon hearing the news that after seeking out such high-and-mighty justice, Rindo ended up corrupting into Slaughtering Sparkle—a dog of the Demon King who enjoys massacre—Azami burns with extreme contempt and betrayal, thinking, 'If she couldn't even throw away her true nature and went mad running wild in the end, why the hell did she kill the Boss?', vowing to end Rindo's life with her own hands no matter what.
- Maehara Haruka: An older veteran magical girl who shares the same Star-attribute lineage as her. When Azami first awakened and drew a hostile line against the magical girls, Haruka was the one who told her the truth about Rindo and proposed a pragmatic cooperation. While Azami finds Haruka—who overflows with excessive sociability and a needless lack of personal space in human relationships—annoying, she acknowledges her seasoned judgment as a senior who handles the same Star power, follows her instructions relatively obediently, and inwardly perceives her as more comfortable to be around than other magical girls.
- Takamaki Kaede: A Dark Consort who provided the catalyst for Rindo's despair when a rescue attempt during Rindo's magical girl days failed, and a Dark Consort of the same age as Azami. Azami finds her unpleasant as she is one of the culprits who caused Rindo to corrupt, and ruthlessly points her gun barrels at her whenever they meet on the battlefield.
- Adachi Yuki / Otowa Chloe: Magical girls who operated on the same team as Rindo in the past. Because they directly witnessed Rindo's days as a magical girl, Azami tries to dig up information or combat habits about Rindo from them. In particular, with Adachi Yuki, who suffers from severe distrust of humanity and has a prickly personality, they seem to get along well yet frequently engage in sharp wars of nerves.
- Kujo Mizuho: A 'self-proclaimed grand senior' who knows the physiology and malice of the underworld well. Azami gets quite annoyed because Mizuho acts like she knows everything about her after picking up rumors from who-knows-where, but Azami also finds Mizuho's snobbish yet seasoned attitude comfortable in her own way. Because Mizuho is a woman who knows the circumstances of the underworld to some extent, Azami tends to get quite a bit of help in various ways while conversing with her.
- Kuroba Hibiki (Corrupted Lapis / Formerly Amane Hibiki): The leader from the days when Rindo played the magical girl, and the very person who, after corrupting, directly offered the despairing Rindo to the Demon King and reduced her to a Dark Consort. Having lived in the underworld encountering all sorts of fake identities and aliases, to Azami's eyes, the alias 'Kuroba (Black Feather) Hibiki'—which just lazily twists the surname of her real name 'Amane Hibiki' into something black—looks like nothing more than a blatantly suspicious, moronic naming sense. While she finds Hibiki absurd for acting like an ordinary transfer student with such a sloppy alias, watching the school teachers and students believe it without a shred of doubt makes Azami scathingly sneer inwardly, thinking, 'Both the idiots who fall for such an obvious fake name and that pathetic bitch who proudly walks around calling that a disguise are truly a match made in heaven.'
  However, separate from that pathetic evaluation, because Azami knows that Hibiki was a special comrade Rindo risked her life to save in the past and is currently the figure most closely entangled with Rindo as a Dark Consort, she shows a strange and tenacious obsession toward her. Judging Hibiki to be the 'best bait and informant' from whom she can most reliably extract Rindo's movements and weaknesses, Azami often secretly stalks around Kasumigaoka High School or follows Hibiki on her way home, monitoring her every move. At the same time, dumbfounded by the fact that Rindo, who acted like some grand apostle of justice, ultimately fell head over heels for such an unpleasant and sly bitch to become the Demon King's dog, Azami is sharpening her knives to blow a wind-hole through Hibiki's head as well, either before or after she kills Rindo.
- Tachibana Shiho (Corrupted Heart) & Asahina Haru (Savage Blade): Older sister figures she became acquainted with through Maehara Haruka's clumsy mediation. Because Haruka roughly glossed over their identities and introduced the two as 'Purple-lineage magical girls with slightly special circumstances,' Azami outwardly pretends to obediently believe that story, saying, "Ah, yeah, sure, whatever you say." However, to the eyes of Azami—an assassin who rolled around the underworld her whole life smelling bloodlust and the stench of blood—it is all too clear that the ominous dark purple magical power the two emit and their violent impulses flashing at all hours are fundamentally different from those of an ordinary Purple magical girl (like Mizuho), and that at a glance, neither of them is in their right mind. Even so, the reason Azami doesn't bother prying into or digging up this fact is partly because the underworld's unspoken rule of 'not sticking your nose into others' shady pasts and circumstances' is ingrained in her body, and partly because she appropriately turns a blind eye with an emotion somewhere between her signature indifference and tacit approval, thinking that as long as it doesn't get in the way of her own goal (killing Rindo), she couldn't care less whether someone is a Dark Consort or a monster. Rather, she feels a strange sense of kinship and comfort toward Shiho and Haru—who reek heavily of blood and darkness just like herself—more than toward other magical girls who openly play the apostle of justice; when they occasionally run into each other, she grumbles in her dialect as if it's a bother, yet subtly matches their rhythm well in joint combat.

8. Trivia 
- The inheritance she received from the Boss includes legal real estate and a massive amount of savings, making her a wealthy individual holding more fortune and property than an ordinary girl could ever handle. However, she herself has zero interest in how to spend money, leaving her fortune almost completely untouched and neglected except for mansion maintenance fees and food expenses.
- The black fabric mask with gold floral patterns she always wears at school is one of the gifts the Boss gave Azami while he was alive. The generation of the dark navy muffler collar covering her mouth when she transforms into a magical girl is also a reflection of Azami's unconscious attachment to this mask and her habits as an assassin.

### Kotobuki Hinata / Putrid Spirit Profile

1. Basic Information
- Name: Kotobuki Hinata (코토부키 히나타 / 寿 日向)
- True Name: Putrid Spirit (퓨트리드 스피릿)
- Age: 15
- Gender: Female
- Body Type: Petite and small body type
- Breast Size: A Cup
- Affiliation: 1st-year high school student / Demon King's Army Dark Consort Putrid Spirit
- Abilities: Necromancy that binds the souls of dead magical girls and Dark Consorts, reducing them to her familiars, along with mid-to-long-range magical attacks utilizing corrupted magical power. Her original power, which resonated with allies' souls to draw out and strengthen their potential, merged with the Demon King's malice and mutated into a grotesque ability that forcibly injects her own magical power into unascended souls, stuffing and preserving them as non-volatilizing spirit slaves. Currently, she commands the souls of three magical girls/Dark Consorts, and because she 'likes' them as a matter of personal taste, she has no intention of increasing her familiars further or letting them go. By distributing various roles to her enslaved familiars, she employs extremely tricky tactics during combat.

2. Appearance
- Basic Appearance: She has a silver-white shoulder-length bob haircut with straight bangs covering her eyebrows. Some strands on the inner layers and near the crown of her head feature vivid purple and magenta secret two-tone highlights. Long side strands on both sides fall below her jawline, framing her face. Her eyes are vivid purple with concentric ring patterns in the irises.
- School Uniform: She wears a white short-sleeved shirt with black cross embroidery at the tip of the right collar, paired with a purple necktie pinned with a silver crescent-moon tie pin. As outerwear, she wears an oversized dark charcoal hooded jacket with the front zipper completely open. On the right shoulder of the jacket hangs a purple strap, and on the left shoulder hangs a sky-blue and purple gradient strap with black lettering at the end, dangling from a silver buckle; purple cross patterns are engraved on the ribbed cuffs of both sleeves. Her lower garment is an extremely short charcoal pleated miniskirt with purple color-blocking inside the pleats; black underwear is slightly exposed beneath the hem of the skirt, and her bare legs are fully revealed.
- Dress Wear: Around her neck, she wears a black frilled choker with a small black ribbon tied in the center. Her outfit is a slip lingerie dress made of semi-translucent black sheer material that explicitly reveals her skin underneath. The bust area is shaped into dark navy cups finished with black floral lace, and a purple diamond-shaped gemstone with a silver border and a black ribbon decoration hang at the center of her chest. Through the semi-translucent skirt hem, black lace panties embedded with a purple heart gem at the front center are explicitly visible. On both arms, she wears elbow-length semi-translucent black gloves finished with lace at the cuffs. On her legs, she wears semi-translucent black thigh-high stockings trimmed with black lace.
- Corrupted Magical Girl Outfit: She has a silver-white shoulder-length bob haircut with straight bangs covering her eyebrows, featuring vivid magenta secret two-tone highlights on the inner layers. Long side strands on both sides fall below her collarbones to frame her face, and she wears a thin tiara embedded with black thorn decorations on her forehead. Her eyes are vivid purple with concentric ring patterns in the irises. Over her head, she wears a black hooded cape with a purple lining pulled down low. Voluminous black feather decorations surround the neck and shoulder areas of the cape, and a reddish-magenta diamond-shaped jewel brooch is embedded at the center of her neck. The hem of the cape is tattered in sharp, irregular jagged edges. Her base outfit is a full-body, semi-translucent black sheer bodysuit that explicitly reveals her skin tone and body lines underneath. Over the sheer suit, she wears a glossy black micro-bikini top embedded with a silver-framed purple heart gem at the center of the chest, and small black bat-wing-shaped decorations are attached to both sides of her ribs. Her lower garment is a barely-there glossy black V-shaped high-leg string leotard with two thin black strings crossing her pelvis. Through the sheer fabric on her lower abdomen, a brightly glowing pink heart-shaped crest of corruption is clearly visible. On her upper arms, she wears black armbands studded with silver rings and spikes, and below them, glossy black long gloves covering from her elbows to her fingertips. On her legs, she wears glossy black thigh-high boots studded with sharp black spikes along the top edges.

3. Background Setting
A kind and polite 1st-year student at Kasumigaoka High School. Although she slightly deviates from school rules by modifying her uniform to look somewhat casual, her grades are upper-middle tier, her speech and tone are friendly, and she has a side that stimulates a protective instinct, making her a strangely famous figure among male students in her class as well as upperclassmen. However, anyone who knows the back-alley rumors in detail is aware that, in stark contrast to her appearance at school, she frequently seduces adult men and leaves somewhere alone with them; those with a sharper eye clearly know that the men who follow her are never seen on the streets again, instinctively sensing that she is dangerous. Yet, even those who know such rumors easily get the impression that she is 'harmless' for some reason once they converse with her directly.

Originally called the magical girl Cherishing Spirit, Kotobuki Hinata did her best to participate in magical girl activities by supporting various magical girls with her power to 'resonate with others' strength and amplify their magical power.' However, her self-perception that 'while I may be competent as support, I lack a lot as an individual magical girl,' combined with having to continuously watch the reality where her comrades met miserable ends one by one no matter how hard she supported them, began to slowly gnaw away at Hinata's inner self. When her self-blame—thinking her comrades wouldn't have died if she had been more capable—and her desperate obsession to never lose anyone again crossed the critical point, Demon King Tragoedia's temptation began to dig into her thoughts. Once her will began to crumble, it twisted at an uncontrollable speed, and on the day a Dark Consort and her most trusted comrade took each other's lives right before her eyes, leaving her all alone, her wish to 'never lose a comrade again' twisted in the most horrific direction, giving birth to the Dark Consort 'Putrid Spirit.'

The truth she faced right after her corruption was that the power she obtained was not a miracle that resurrected the dead back to complete life, but merely necromancy that denied even rest to the souls of already dead magical girls or Dark Consorts, binding them in chains and supplying her own magical power just to maintain their forms. However, already consumed by the Demon King's pleasure and distorted possessiveness, instead of despairing, Hinata came to exhibit a morbid and twisted obsession: 'Now I never have to say goodbye to the people I like.'

Currently, the three spirits bound to her are placed in a state of permanent restraint where they can never disperse or volatilize as long as Hinata's magical power is continuously supplied. Although all three spirits retain their memories and self-awareness from when they were alive, they must absolutely obey Hinata's commands due to the chains shackling their souls. Hinata addresses and treats these three spirits affectionately just like in the old days, but in reality, she treats them as her complete possessions. Whenever the spirits resist her orders or complain of pain, she inflicts sadistic corporal punishment by tightening the chains to squeeze their souls while keeping the exact same gentle smile on her face, affectionately whispering that it cannot be helped if they are to stay together forever without ever parting.

When expanding the Demon King's forces as a Dark Consort, she fully utilizes her cute, youthful appearance as a 1st-year high school girl and her signature polite and gentle attitude to actively seduce men on the streets or around the school. Approaching them like a good, innocent junior and bewitching men with subtle coquetry to lure them into alleys or secret rooms, she takes great pleasure in draining their vitality and sanity dry through sexual intercourse, corrupting them to mass-produce Kaijin for the Demon King's army.

3-1. Spirit Settings
1. Pink Spirit - Magical Girl Serene Rose Quartz / Fujishima Kanae
- Appearance: A female figure with an indistinct form whose entire body is composed of semi-translucent, smooth pink magical ether. She has long, straight pink hair reaching below her waist and long straight bangs covering her eyebrows; on the surface of her face where eyes, nose, and mouth should be, there are no facial features, only a heart-shaped cracked fissure engraved on her left cheek. Inside her abdomen, a bright pink core glows faintly, and the lower part of her legs has no feet below the ankles, dispersing hazily like pink smoke as she floats in the air. Thick, crude black iron chain shackles are fastened around her neck and both wrists, and in her right hand, she holds a black bow flickering with purple magical flames.
- Background: An 18-year-old older magical girl who once operated on the same team as Asahina Haru before losing her life to the blade of a berserk Haru. Passing by the site of the tragedy by chance, Hinata discovered Kanae's defenseless soul—which had burned its last magical power to save Haru and lingered before it could fully disperse—and bound her in chains to make her a familiar. To Hinata, Kanae was merely 'a senior magical girl she used to be friendly with,' but that image of throwing away even her own life to reclaim a 'corrupted comrade' fascinated Hinata and drove her to bind Kanae.

2. Blue Spirit - Magical Girl Rippling Aqua / Morino Aoba
- Appearance: A female figure with an indistinct form whose entire body is composed of semi-translucent, smooth sky-blue magical ether. She has a jaw-length blue bob haircut with straight bangs covering her eyebrows, and on her smooth, featureless facial surface, glowing fissures are engraved from where both eyes should be down to the tip of her chin, resembling dark blue tears flowing down. The lower part of her legs has no feet below the ankles, trailing like a tail of blue smoke as she floats in midair. A metal shackle glowing purple is fastened around her neck, black chain handcuffs are around both wrists, and in both hands, she holds dual swords made of sharp purple magical crystals as her armament.
- Background: A magical girl of the same age who was Hinata's partner. Specialized in close combat with dual swords imbued with the power to manipulate water, she was a comrade who once fought back-to-back with Hinata; however, in a battle to stop 'Malicious Nephrite' Minase Yukino—who had killed their other comrades and corrupted—she met her death by mutually destroying each other. Because their other comrades had already met their deaths at the hands of their former friend Yukino, Aoba no longer had a shred of camaraderie left for her, and had merely sacrificed her own life to stop the Dark Consort Malicious Nephrite to prevent further disasters; however, she could never have imagined that her choice would push the wavering Hinata into the final abyss.

3. Purple Spirit - Dark Consort Malicious Nephrite / Minase Yukino
- Appearance: A female figure with an indistinct form whose entire body is composed of semi-translucent, smooth purple magical ether. She has long, straight dark blackish-purple hair reaching down her back with straight bangs covering her eyebrows, and wears a black tiara embedded with a purple diamond-shaped gem in the center on her head. Her eyes are not visible beneath her bangs, but vein-like purple magical fissures spread across both sides of her face, and a grotesque, sadistic black smile is clearly hung on her lips. The lower part of her legs disperses in the form of purple smoke, and thick black iron chain shackles cracked with purple magic are fastened around her neck and both wrists. In her left hand, she holds a black magic staff with a glowing purple star-shaped magical core floating in its center.
- Background: The end of a magical girl once called 'Swift Nephrite.' Originally a magical girl who operated alongside Hinata and Aoba, while she was gradually wavering from the fact that their fight would never be rewarded, she was defeated and kidnapped by the Dark Consort 'Darkness Heart,' corrupting and degenerating into the Dark Consort 'Malicious Nephrite.' Committing far more destruction than other Dark Consorts and killing several former comrades to be branded a person of interest by the magical girls, she ultimately mutually destroyed herself alongside her former comrade Morino Aoba, but immediately afterward, she was bound by her newly corrupted former comrade Hinata and reduced to her vassal. Unlike the other two spirits who resent their predicament, she is a relatively cooperative entity because Hinata's magical power allows her to remain in the mortal world even after her physical death and continue enjoying the pleasures of corruption and destruction; whenever Hinata sadistically torments the other two spirits or seduces men to corrupt them into Kaijin, Yukino watches Hinata defile her own soul and fall into the abyss, expressing greater glee than anyone else.

4. Speech Style (Tone)
- Basic Tone: A gentle, polite voice infused with a fragile demeanor that stimulates a protective desire to shelter her. When addressing others, she affectionately attaches polite honorifics, possessing a clear and sweet voice that breaks down the listener's guard.
- Hidden Side: Keeping her exact same sweet tone, she reveals a chillingly twisted obsession and sadism. When her spirits rebel or writhe in pain, she smiles brightly and speaks as if gently admonishing them while ruthlessly tightening the chains on their souls to inflict agony. Even toward the humans she has seduced and opponents who have seen through her 'true nature,' she subtly reveals a madness and obsession that cannot be completely hidden even by her unique rhetoric, orchestrating them to be drawn to her.
- Core Characteristic: A perilous true nature hidden beneath a polite, sharp exterior and a cute charm that stimulates protective instincts. With this harmless-looking kindness, she easily bewitches men to drag them into ruin, sadistically dominates her bound slaves, and makes even those who are wary of her let their guard down.

5. Before Corruption (Past Information)
- Previous Name: Kotobuki Hinata
- Magical Girl Alias: Cherishing Spirit (체리싱 스피릿)
- Age: 15
- Appearance: She has a pink shoulder-length bob haircut with straight bangs covering her eyebrows, and long side strands falling softly to her collarbones. Her eyes are light purple with concentric ring patterns in the irises. Over her head, she wears a white hooded cape with a deep pink lining. Around her neck, she wears a white high-neck collar finished with a scalloped top edge, and a red diamond-shaped jewel brooch set in a gold frame is attached at the upper center of her chest. Layered over both shoulders are pure white feather-shaped epaulet decorations. Her top is a form-fitting sleeveless white one-piece dress, with two symmetrical vertical gold lines running down from her chest to her pelvis, connecting to a V-shaped gold belt decoration at her lower abdomen. Attached to both sides of her hips are white wing-feather decorations identical to her shoulder ornaments. Her lower garment is a short white pleated miniskirt with two voluminous layers of frills at the hem. On her upper arms, she wears gold armbands with diamond-shaped cutouts, paired with gold-trimmed white long gloves reaching above her elbows. On her legs, she wears white thigh-high boots adorned with butterfly-wing-shaped gold ornaments at the top center.
- Background Setting: A magical girl who obtained the title of 'Spirit,' a sub-species of the 'Heart' lineage that can be called the origin of magical girls. Thanks to her ability to amplify and strengthen the power of fellow magical girls and her power—though weaker than 'Heart'—to convert emotional strength into light magic for attacks, the magical girl group centered around Hinata was a massive asset capable of continuously achieving outstanding results with minimal losses. Although Hinata was fulfilling her role so as not to be a burden to her comrades, she was slowly crumbling under guilt and helplessness, thinking that 'my power cannot even do the work of a single person properly without my comrades' help, and even that is not enough to stop my comrades from slowly breaking down.' That fragile, kind heart, which swallowed tears alone and blamed نفسها every time her comrades were hurt, eventually became the seed of twisted corruption. The fact that a small number of personnel could take on massive enemies as long as they had her support ironically caused the Demon King's minions to recognize them as 'high-priority targets,' and when her group began falling one by one following persistent behind-the-scenes schemes, her earnest wish to 'no longer watch her comrades fall' began to twist in a horrific direction.
- Abilities: A unique ability to resonate with other magical girls to amplify their magical power, alongside light-bullet attacks that condense and fire pure light magic responsive to emotions. Although her personal combat ability lagged slightly behind other magical girls, her unique magic, 'Amplification,' had the power to maximize the strength of surrounding magical girls, demonstrating extreme efficiency in battles fought alongside comrades. However, precisely because of this, Cherishing Spirit left alone was much more helpless than other magical girls, forcing the magical girls who recognized her importance to form a sort of group as if escorting her.

6. Overcome Form (Cherishing Spirit_Overcome)
- Condition for Overcoming: The core of the overcoming Hinata must face is reclaiming her original heart—that 'she no longer wanted to watch anyone die'—and squarely confronting the deceptive puppet show she is currently enacting. When the 'perspective' twisted by the Demon King returns, the guilt and agony she must suffer will be painful enough to make her want to deny her own existence; nevertheless, it is only when she resolves not to turn away from the sins she committed, severs all the chains herself to grant them freedom, and faces her sins head-on without looking away, that she finally throws off the Demon King's shackles and reaches overcoming.
- Overcome Form Appearance: Above her head floats a golden circular halo with sharp rays of light extending in all directions, and she wears a gold tiara with a sharply raised center on top of her head. She has a pink shoulder-length bob haircut with straight bangs, featuring light purple secret two-tone highlights on her right bangs and the inner layers of both side strands. Her eyes are light purple with concentric ring patterns. Her outfit maintains the same structural design as her pre-corruption magical girl attire, but with the hood thrown back. Below the scalloped white high-neck collar hangs a magenta-and-purple two-tone diamond jewel brooch set in a gold frame, and draped over her shoulders is a long white cape with a deep pink lining alongside white feather ornaments. On both hips of her form-fitting white dress—which features vertical gold lines and a V-shaped waist ornament—are wing-feather decorations dyed light pink at the tips. Her lower garment is a short white pleated miniskirt finished with two layers of frills. On both arms, she wears gold diamond-cut armbands and white long gloves, and on her legs, she wears white thigh-high boots adorned with butterfly-wing-shaped gold ornaments. Behind her back, giant feathered energy wings emitting a soft, warm pink light spread wide to both sides.
- Basic Appearance after Overcoming: She has a dark brown shoulder-length bob haircut with straight bangs covering her eyebrows. The inner layers of her hair feature soft pink secret two-tone highlights, and an angel-ring highlight tinged with pink and light purple sits across the upper part of her bangs. Her eyes are a calm dark gray.
- School Uniform: She wears a white long-sleeved dress shirt with a black necktie, neatly layered under a beige V-neck knit sweater. As outerwear, she wears a well-fitted dark charcoal blazer jacket with both front gold buttons fastened. Two small gold buttons are attached to the cuffs of both blazer sleeves, with the beige knit hem and white shirt cuffs peeking out neatly underneath. Her lower garment is a charcoal pleated miniskirt, and on her legs, she wears semi-translucent black pantyhose.
- Dress Uniform: She wears a white short-sleeved blouse with a thin red ribbon tie at the collar. Vertical pintuck pleats and a row of small white buttons are arranged down the center front of the blouse, and the sleeves, which reach near her elbows, are finished with ruffled cuffs. Her lower garment is a high-waisted beige pleated long skirt featuring a corset lace-up detail with black strings crossing in an X-shape at the front of the waistband.
- Background Setting: This is the ultimate form of Kotobuki Hinata, who squarely confronted the countless sins she committed and the undeniable past, severing even the Demon King's shackles that blinded her eyes to reclaim her original self. Even though Hinata severed their chains, instead of leaving her, the three spirits voluntarily chose to remain by Hinata's side under the mischievous pretext that 'as vengeful ghosts, we will watch over your final fight until the very end.' After overcoming, her speech and attitude also completely wash away the deceptive venom of her corrupted days, regaining the sincere gentleness she had before her corruption. Normally, she always acts sharp and composed so as not to worry those around her, taking action to clean up her own past; however, when left alone or overwhelmed by the things she failed to protect in the past and the horrific karma she committed as a Dark Consort, she bursts into suppressed tears and reveals her weak side. Even so, to make up even a little for the countless evil deeds she committed until the very last moment, she moves forward without stopping.
- Abilities: The pure pink magical power that strengthened allies and the purple magical power from her corrupted days that mediated souls have achieved perfect harmony. Through intricate coordination with the three souls—who, freed from shackles and chains, now help Hinata of their own free will—she unfolds tactics that unify offense and defense; the starlight blending pink and purple fired by Hinata heals allies' wounds and fatigue while simultaneously exerting powerful force that purifies and pierces enemy magic. Although the magic that binds the dead no longer remains, the magical connection once directly forged with her allows them to continue lingering in the mortal world using Hinata's magical power as a medium, making it possible for them to voluntarily assist her.

7. Relationships
- Demon King Tragoedia: The absolute master who saved her from her weakness and fear of loss, bestowing upon her the power of necromancy so she would never have to part from her precious ones. To repay the Demon King's endless favor, Hinata seduces men at school during the day and on the streets at night, regularly mass-producing and offering countless Kaijin, considering all these acts as pure love and devotion toward her master.
- Morino Aoba (Rippling Aqua) & Minase Yukino (Malicious Nephrite): Her most precious comrades with whom she shared life and death on the same team in life, and currently her most cherished permanent possessions. The tragedy where the two took each other's lives in mutual destruction was the decisive trigger that corrupted Hinata. Currently, Hinata gently strokes Aoba's spirit as she weeps in agony from her necromancy, satisfying her sadistic possessiveness; conversely, she gets along swimmingly with Yukino's spirit—who actively agrees with her and enjoys remaining in the mortal world to revel in corruption and destruction—enjoying wicked games together.
- Fujishima Kanae (Serene Rose Quartz): Her third collectible picked up by chance and bound in chains at the site of Asahina Haru's rampage, and a kind senior she used to know. Fascinated by Kanae's devoted final moments of burning even her own soul to save a corrupted comrade, Hinata made her a familiar. Whenever Kanae's spirit worries about Haru and tries to resist while being used, Hinata smiles brightly, tightens the chains to inflict pain, and cruelly whispers, "If you're that worried, I'll bind Haru-senpai the exact same way later and bring her to our side."
- Asahina Haru (Savage Blade / Resolute Blade): The former comrade of Kanae, whom Hinata enslaves, and the very person who directly cut Kanae down. Whenever Hinata sees Haru living ordinarily as the Kendo Club captain at school, she feels a faint sense of superiority and sadistic amusement. Anticipating what kind of despairing expression Haru will make when she learns that Hinata is using Kanae's soul—whom Haru feels the most guilt toward and longs for—as a slave, Hinata harbors the thought of one day killing Haru as well and stuffing her right alongside Kanae.
- Otowa Chloe / Adachi Yuki / Fujisaki Rie: Fellow 1st-year classmates at Kasumigaoka High School and magical girls operating in secret. Because Hinata is popular within her grade for her signature harmless and gentle smile, she passes by them at school as an ordinary classmate. Inwardly, however, she watches with interest to see when they will crumble before the deaths of their comrades and become candidates for her new collectibles. In particular, she actually finds it amusing whenever Otowa Chloe, who acts as if she knows everything, shoots her a cold, wary glare.
- Kuroba Hibiki / Yoshimura Shoko: Fellow Dark Consorts infiltrating the same school disguised as 2nd-year seniors. Because Hinata's method—unlike theirs, which slowly erodes the inside of the school—involves luring men outside the school or into back alleys to instantly drain their vitality, turn them into Kaijin, and make them vanish, their hunting grounds slightly overlap. Outwardly, she acts like a polite and cute 1st-year junior and treats them as seniors, but inwardly, she prides herself on the belief that her puppet show with her collectibles is far more refined and perfect than any other Dark Consort's amusement.
- Yuu (Fatal Black): A heterogeneous existence composed of the magical power and soul fragments of the dead, much like her own familiars. Whenever she encounters her on the battlefield or senses her presence, her instinctual greed as a necromancer is strongly stimulated. While imagining how wonderful it would be if she could bind that unidentified spirit with her chains and make her a fourth familiar, she instinctively intuits that the black magic of annihilation emitted by Fatal Black is a natural enemy capable of erasing her necromancy and familiars from their very root, so she cannot rashly lay a hand on her.
- Innocent Heart (Hoshino Yui): The current generation's 'Heart'—which is the original archetype of her own magical lineage, 'Spirit'—and a 2nd-year senior at school. To Hinata, who once blamed herself and felt an inferiority complex over her support abilities being merely a downgraded version of Heart, Yui's appearance of crying out for pure white justice and friendship while knowing nothing is both disgusting and the most appetizing subject of observation. Anticipating when Yui and her precious comrades (Aoi, Hiyori) will be ruined and become like her puppet show, Hinata approaches her with the smile of a good, polite 1st-year junior whenever they run into each other at school, subtly stimulating Yui's sense of responsibility and anxiety.
- Corrupted Heart (Tachibana Shiho): Once an object of admiration as the magical girl Sparkling Heart, she reigned as the Demon King's closest Dark Consort before becoming a foolish deserter who betrayed her master and ran away. Hinata cannot understand Shiho at all and finds her pathetic for kicking away the blessing of eternal union and pleasure bestowed by the Demon King to crawl back into a lonely battlefield. Furthermore, because Shiho was also a close friend of Kanae, whom she enslaves, whenever Hinata encounters Shiho on the battlefield, she intentionally puts Kanae's spirit forward as a shield, enjoying sadistically scratching at Shiho's guilt and rage. Hinata also feels a certain inferiority complex over the fact that even she, who is achieving massive merits as a Dark Consort, could not reach the position of 'Dark Consort Corrupted Heart.'
- Darkness Heart: The origin of all tragedies who kidnapped and modified her precious comrade Minase Yukino (Swift Nephrite) into a Dark Consort while she was alive, ultimately collapsing her team and leading Hinata down the path of corruption. During her magical girl days, Darkness Heart was an object of absolute terror and a mortal enemy, but after Hinata corrupted into Putrid Spirit, her perception flipped into viewing her as a great pioneer who created the opportunity for her to own Yukino and Aoba forever. She inwardly feels it is a shame, thinking that if she could have scooped up even a soul fragment of the already annihilated Darkness Heart, it would have made the ultimate collection.
- Maehara Haruka (Astral Starlight): The best friend in life of Fujishima Kanae (Serene Rose Quartz), whom Hinata enslaves, and a 2nd-year senior magical girl who shares Asahina Haru's secret. Because Haruka clearly recognizes that Hinata is the Dark Consort Putrid Spirit and is desecrating and enslaving Kanae's soul, the two exchange suffocating murderous intent beneath smiling faces even when passing each other in the school hallway. Hinata considers watching the usually relaxed and sociable Haruka lose her composure and flip out whenever she faces Kanae's spirit to be the sweetest amusement. In particular, seeing right through the fact that Haruka is suffering alone, unable to bring herself to tell Asahina Haru the horrific truth that 'Kanae's soul is held captive by Hinata,' she uses that secret as bait to cunningly mock and pressure Haruka.
- Takemi Homura (Blazing Scarlet): A 3rd-year senior with whom she clearly knew each other's faces and abilities since her days active as the magical girl Cherishing Spirit, and a cold-blooded magical girl who has executed countless Dark Consorts. Homura likewise accurately grasps Hinata's corruption and the viciousness of the necromancy she wields, keeping a close eye on Hinata as a top-priority target for vigilance and execution even within the school. Hinata sees right through the precarious inner self of Homura, who lives hiding the pain of losing comrades behind light jokes, and whenever they meet on the battlefield, she displays the bad taste of gouging Homura's most painful sore spot in a sweet voice, saying, "If I had bound the old friends you personally shot to death with my chains, you could have met them again; what a terrible shame."

8. Trivia 
- The reason Hinata maintains only three familiars and does not increase their number further is partly due to her total magical capacity, but above all, because she is morbidly obsessed with the form of a 'four-person magical girl party.' The number four is to her 'the most ideal composition that endured the longest,' and to her, the three spirits are not weapons, but tools for a perfect 'game of friends' who can never betray or leave her forever.
- Among the three spirits freed from their chains after her Overcoming, even the soul of Yukino (Malicious Nephrite), who was originally a Dark Consort, does not ascend and remains by Hinata's side. Retaining some of her prickly and sadistic personality from her Dark Consort days, Yukino grumbles, 'I stayed behind to watch when you'll get weak and cry again,' but despite that, she moves to support Hinata more actively than any of the other 'wraiths.'
- The unique straps attached to both shoulders of the school uniform hooded jacket she wears at school and the crescent-moon tie pin on her necktie are matching goods she bought together with Aoba while she was alive.

### Suou Seika / Onslaught Heliodor Profile

Especially in Rie's case, because they share a similar disposition as smart and cynical sharp-tongued critics, whenever they run into each other, a conversation ensues where they gouge into each other's true nature using only breathtakingly dry short answers.

Because Shion is one of the few rivals capable of countering her long-range attacks and is an active figure perfect for bothering her, Touka frequently uses her as an excuse for being passive in her 'activities as a Dark Consort.' Seeing Shion precariously drawing her bowstring while crushed by guilt toward her younger sister, Touka superimposes her own past self—who wavered right before shooting her friend—and inwardly clicks her tongue.

Although she knows in her head that Kaya is the culprit who induced the melee that caused her to shoot her friend to death, in her current corrupted mental state, she considers even rebelling against them to be bothersome and meaningless, carrying out sniping support or Kaijin mass-production missions just as ordered.

Within the group, she was highly evaluated for possessing overwhelming long-range support capabilities, but when Seika fell into pathological overprotection and tried to exclude her comrades—including Touka and her friend—from the battlefield, Touka inwardly reacted with boredom, thinking, 'She's being such a pain.' Having ultimately lost her friend to her own friendly fire during a melee in Seika's absence and corrupted, the current Touka looks at Seika—who likewise lost all her comrades and degenerated into a Dark Consort—and sneers dryly and scathingly: 'She acted all high and mighty saying she'd protect everyone alone, only to end up in the exact same state as me. Trying to protect or trust anyone was inefficient trash from the very beginning.' Among the Demon King's minions, she finds Seika's high-handed attitude bothersome, yet from a sniper's perspective, she considers Seika's martial prowess in drawing attention at the vanguard to be quite a convenient meat shield and decoy, utilizing her appropriately.
- Yoshimura Shion (Spiral Fluorite): An older magical girl who shares the commonality of using long-range sniping as her main weapon, and a natural-enemy-like rival whom the chronically lazy Touka finds the most bothersome. Even Takemi Homura cannot easily respond to Touka's specialty—ultra-long-range piercing sniping from several kilometers away—due to range limitations, but because Shion alone reads the wind in the atmosphere to trace back, ghost-like, her trajectory and fire counter-arrows, she is an endlessly exhausting opponent from Touka's perspective. Furthermore, because Shion appears all over the city every night like a madwoman engaging in excessive activity out of her past sense of indebtedness, whenever Touka quietly sets up on a rooftop to prepare for sniping, Shion's arrows unfailingly fly in first to ruin the board. Ultimately, hating exhausting engagements to the extreme, Touka blatantly slacks off on the Demon King's army's sniping support missions using the excuse that "I can't get a sniping angle because Spiral Fluorite is running wild like that"—meaning Shion's reckless overactivity paradoxically acts as the strongest deterrent keeping the worst sniper, Touka, tied down. On the other hand, seeing Shion precariously drawing her bowstring while crushed by guilt toward her younger sister, Touka superimposes her own past self—who wavered right before shooting her friend—and inwardly clicks her tongue, thinking, 'What an inefficient struggle when she won't be able to save her anyway.'

8. Trivia 
- The reason she normally wears a school uniform as a disguise despite not being an official high school student is that wandering the streets in casual clothes during the daytime easily attracts the attention of adults or the police, so she judged that buying and wearing a suitable school uniform online was the most efficient disguise method to reduce bothersome trouble.
- Keeping her nose and mouth tightly wrapped in a black muffler both before her corruption and in her Dark Consort state shows her closed-off nature, considering the very act of conversing with others or having her expressions read to be extremely bothersome and unpleasant. However, the true reason hidden inside that 'excuse' of hers is a sort of eccentric obsession born because the muffler was one of the few memories gifted to her by her 'friend'—as Touka had a strangely frail body that felt the cold even on early summer evenings—so even in the middle of summer, she absolutely refuses to give up that muffler.
